title: Horizon Implementation Day: Novelties in the 2026-2027 Horizon Europe work programme
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: The Commission's briefing on what changes for applicants under the 2026-2027 work programme: the application process and evaluation criteria, the Choose Europe for Science actions and the roll-out of two-factor authentication in the Funding & Tenders Portal.
covers: Novelties in the application process and the evaluation criteria
Novelties in the Choose Europe for Science actions, presented by the Research Executive Agency and DG Education and Culture
The gradual roll-out of two-factor authentication in the Funding & Tenders Portal
materials: Video recording, agenda and presentation slides for each session
why: Anyone writing a proposal for the 2026-2027 calls should watch the first block before drafting: changes to templates and criteria apply to every topic in the work programme.
